problem.title: Customers ask — you don’t reply in time.
problem.hint: Especially evenings, weekends, and busy hours — when the best leads often arrive.

items.0: The same questions again and again: prices, availability, what you offer, how to book.
items.1: Visitors land when nobody is online — and leave without a message.
items.2: Phone and email pile up; slow replies lose jobs to whoever answers first.
items.3: Your team spends hours on simple replies instead of real work.
items.4: You have no clear record of who asked what — leads disappear in chat apps and missed calls.

solution.title: An AI assistant that knows your business.
solution.subtitle: Customers get instant help. You get organised leads and fewer missed opportunities.

0.title: Answers from your content
0.body: Prices, services, opening hours, locations, and FAQs — grounded in your website and documents, not made-up answers.

1.title: Knows your business

2.title: Qualifies visitors

3.title: Saves leads automatically
3.body: Name, phone, email, and the full chat transcript land in your dashboard (and optional email alerts).

4.title: Hands off to a human
4.body: When the conversation needs you, the bot can collect contacts and flag it for follow-up.

5.title: Books appointments
5.body: With calendar connected, visitors can request a time without calling during work hours.

pricing.setupBody: We configure the chatbot for your business: website crawl, knowledge base, widget on your site, lead capture, and go-live. Paid once — not every month.

setupIncludes.2: Lead fields & greeting tailored to you

pricing.setupNote: Then add a monthly plan (Starter / Business / Pro). Free DIY stays available without the setup fee.

0.a: It is a one-time payment for us to set up the chatbot for you — crawl your site, build the knowledge base, configure the widget and lead capture, and help you go live. It is not a monthly charge.

1.a: Yes. After setup you choose a monthly plan (Starter, Business, or Pro) based on how many conversations you need. The monthly fee covers hosting, AI replies, and your dashboard.

2.q: Can I skip the setup fee?
2.a: Yes. The Free plan is self-serve: create an account, add your site, and install the widget yourself — no €290 fee. Paid setup is for businesses that want it done for them.

3.a: No. With paid setup we guide the install. DIY only needs pasting one script snippet into your website.

4.q: How fast does it go live?
4.a: DIY: often within minutes after indexing. With done-for-you setup: typically within a few business days after we have your website and details.

5.a: No. It answers from your website and the knowledge you provide. If it is unsure, it can ask for contact details and hand off to you.

6.a: Your TavsWebs Bot dashboard — name, contact details, and the chat transcript. You can also get email alerts on paid plans.

7.a: Yes. The product and assistant work in Latvian and English.

8.q: Can I cancel the monthly plan?
8.a: Yes, anytime from the dashboard. The one-time setup fee is non-recurring.

9.a: A visitor chat session with the assistant. Limits reset each billing month according to your plan.
